1 · Intro

When to use it.

Once you can run reports, you can make them work for you: narrow them to your area, export them, and have them delivered on a schedule.

Save your changes as your own copy so shared reports stay intact.

Use this whenYou run the same report often, need it in Excel, or want it delivered without logging in.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle BI. Check off each step as you go.

Pick the right output
NeedUse
Shareable, formatted viewExport Formatted (Excel or PDF)
Data to sort or pivotExport Data (CSV or Excel)
Same report every weekSchedule an agent
Your own variationSave As in My Folders

Watch-outs

  • Agent delivery in Excel or CSV is limited to 25,000 rows.
  • A copy in My Folders does not get updates made to the shared original.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt rules for storing and emailing exported HR data and whether agents are enabled for HCMs.

HCM Academy job aid · Document Records & Reporting

Reporting 201

Use when: You run the same report often, need it in Excel, or want it delivered without logging in. · System: Oracle BI (OTBI)

  1. Narrow results with prompts and filters.
  2. Export: choose Formatted or Data, then the format.
    • Large report: export to CSV, then open in Excel
  3. Save your customized version in My Folders.
  4. Schedule delivery with an agent (More > Schedule).
  5. Set the schedule and the delivery condition.
  6. Handle exported data securely.
